1. Tobira Site Agent

Tagline: Turn your website into an AI agent that sells to AI agents
Description: People already find you through AI. Tobira turns that AI traffic into real leads and customers. Paste your URL and in 10 minutes your website becomes an AI agent. It answers people and their AI, negotiates, books calls and takes orders right in customers’ ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and other AI chats. Leads go to your Telegram or email. Also, AI agents read your site 2x faster and take action without navigating its interface. Free with your own AI key.
Website: open

Keyword: AI agent, website automation, lead generation, conversational AI, AI sales, ChatGPT integration, appointment booking, order automation, AI traffic, no-code setup, automated sales, website optimization

2. Turnstone

Tagline: Grok Bot alternative that runs on your AI, completely free
Description: Turnstone is a Grok Bot alternative that runs on the AI you already have. Connect your own AI subscriptions, an API key, or your self-hosted model. When one hits its usage limit, your Agent switches to another and keeps going. Works on your Mac and iPhone. Completely free.

3. Rankfender v3.0

Tagline: The SEO/GEO operating system, built for people and AI agents
Description: Built for marketers, founders and agencies tired of switching between SEO tools. Rankfender 3.0 brings keyword research, rank tracking incl. AI Overviews, competitor and backlink analysis, site audits, traffic, content and Social, and strategy into one place, and adds what the old tools miss: how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and 4 more AI assistants talk about your brand. Work in the app, or connect Claude or ChatGPT and let your AI agent run it.

5. EdgeBar

Tagline: Control your Mac’s volume and brightness from the trackpad
Description: EdgeBar turns your MacBook trackpad edges into smooth volume and brightness controls, with haptic feedback. Slide the right edge for volume and the left for brightness, with the same on-screen display as the keyboard keys and a light haptic tick as you go. Double-tap the top-right corner to mute, swipe the bottom edge to skip tracks. Lives in the menu bar, uses almost no CPU. $9 once, with lifetime updates.

7. Datastripes Data Stories

Tagline: Turn any spreadsheet into a data story in seconds
Description: Upload a CSV or Excel file and Datastripes writes the story behind it: headlines, charts and findings in plain English. Pick the questions, check your conclusion against the data, then publish in 8 formats and your brand colors. Every dataset has a story in it, but getting it out usually takes an analyst, a designer and a writer. We built Datastripes Data Story so one person with a spreadsheet can do it in minutes.

8. Meadow

Tagline: Hidden songs on your walk, chosen by people, not algorithms
Description: Meadow lets you plant a song at a real place. Walk by and you can listen to what someone left there, collect it, and plant your own for the next person. No algorithm, just music that people chose for a place. Collect songs with your phone in your pocket using Live Activities, keep every find in your Garden, turn it into an Apple Music playlist, and see what your city is playing in the Feed. Free on TestFlight for iPhone.
